biography.value:
Description

Reminiscent of a flaming chicken but twice the size, a Hot Wings is a phoenix-like monster that you're best off not calling a “Phoenix,” lest the mighty Primal or any of his worshippers take offense. - Imban

Defense

AC 21, touch 16, flat-footed 16 (+4 Dex, +1 dodge, +5 natural, +1 size)

hp 75 [120] (10d10+20); fast healing 3

mp 14

Fort +9, Ref +11, Will +7

Immune fire; Resist earth 10, ice 50%

SR 19

Weakness water

Offense

Speed 20 ft., fly 100 ft. (good)

Melee bite +15 (1d4+1 plus 1d6 fire)

Special Attacks Flame Sweep, Stone Beak

Spells Known (SC CL 8th; concentration +14)

2nd (DC 16) - Cure II

Statistics

Str 12, Dex 19, Con 14, Int 10, Wis 15, Cha 19

Base Atk +10; CMB +10; CMD 25

Feats Dodge, Flyby Attack, Iron Will, Mobility, Weapon Finesse

Skills Fly +23, Perception +15

SQ Shroud of Flame

Ecology

Environment volcanic regions

Organization small group (1-3)

Treasure incidental

description.value: Once every 1d4 rounds as a full-round action, a hot wings can become a streak of blazing fire, moving its speed, even through squares occupied by enemies, without provoking attacks of opportunity. Creatures whose squares the hot wings passed through suffer 5d6 fire damage and begin Burning as though affected by a 5th-level spell, with a DC 19 Reflex save to halve the damage and negate the status effect.

effect: Move your speed without AoOs, affect only creatures in squares passed through.

damages.raw: 19 Reflex save to halve the damage

description.value: A hot wings can cause its feathers to burst into fire or stop burning as a free action. As long as its feathers are burning, it inflicts an additional 1d6 points of fire damage with each natural attack, and any creature within reach (5 feet for most hot wings) must make a DC 17 Reflex save each round to avoid taking 1d6 points of fire damage at the start of its turn. A creature that attacks the hot wings with natural or non-reach melee weapons takes 1d6 points of fire damage (no save) with each successful hit. The save DC is Constitution-based.

effect: Use detailed ability DC 17; headline aura says 19.
Toggle feathers. While active use the burning bite. Aura and contact damage are separate.
No save: natural or non-reach melee hit.

description.value: 3/day as a standard action, a hot wings can inflict a painful peck that has a chance of turning its victim to stone. If they succeed at hitting with their bite attack, the damage is 1d4+1 x 1.5 plus 1d6 fire damage, and the victim must make a Fortitude save (DC 19) or suffer the Petrify status.

effect: Multiply physical damage only; roll fire separately.
